item.text: To book a room, first send us the date and time you would like to use it. We will then check whether the room is available during that period. After receiving your request, we will send a message confirming that we got it. Please note that this confirmation only means we received your request; it does not mean the room has been approved or reserved. We will let you know separately once availability has been confirmed.
